name: job-search-agent
description: The dashboard now includes a versioned candidate profile, deterministic hard eligibility gates, cached offline semantic matching, explainable hybrid rankings and an optional zero-budget-by-default LLM adapter. Employment skills, AI project skills and learning skills remain separate; no professional AI tenure is inferred. A PDF/DOCX resume can be referenced locally under ignored `data/resumes/`, but it is never automatically edited or treated as verified facts.
